title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Cancellation and Resource Limit Work Item
summary: Add focused DoQ stream cancellation, cancellation-volume, reset, internal-error, and dangling-stream limit behavior.
planned_changes:
- Add `DoqServerOptions` for bounded connection-local resource policy.
- Map client query cancellation to read-side abort with `DOQ_REQUEST_CANCELLED`.
- Track active accepted query streams and close the connection with `DOQ_EXCESSIVE_LOAD` when the configured dangling-stream limit is exceeded.
- Enforce configured cancellation-request volume with `MaxCancellationRequests` and close the connection with `DOQ_EXCESSIVE_LOAD` when the limit is exceeded.
- Treat early client stream resets as request cancellation without dispatching incomplete DNS messages.
- Map unexpected DNS handler failures to `DOQ_INTERNAL_ERROR` stream aborts.
- Add focused loopback tests and a requirement-home test for the cancellation/resource-limit slice.
verification_plan: Run the DoQ stream lifecycle tests, the RFC 9250 requirement-home tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: DNS SERVFAIL response mapping for resolver-originated failures.
0-RTT, Retry/address-validation policy, and external DoQ interop proof.
completion_notes: The DoQ adapter now has verified stream cancellation/reset handling, cancellation-volume limit enforcement, internal-error abort mapping, and opt-in dangling-stream connection closure. Remaining RFC 9250 work stays explicitly trace-owned instead of being hidden in this slice.
